meta.method: Figma MCP use_figma (Plugin API, read-only): local variables (all modes) + local paint/text styles. Values are verbatim from Figma; hex is #RRGGBB[AA].
meta.colorFormat: #RRGGBBAA hex; *_css is the same value as rgb()/rgba().
meta.aliases: {"alias": "<Collection>/<Variable>", "resolved": value} means the variable points at another variable in Figma.

missing.accessibleIncreasedContrastColors: Not present as variables/modes in either kit (Colors collections only have Light and Dark modes). The Colors pages (iOS 0:1746, macOS 0:687) were not read node-by-node because the Figma MCP monthly quota ran out; any contrast swatches drawn on those pages are unread.
missing.ios.materials: iOS Materials page (215:105157) not read (quota). No iOS material paint/effect styles exist; Liquid Glass parameters are captured from Kit variables in ios.liquidGlass, and blur/fill appear per component in components/ios/*.md where read.

missing.shadows: Neither kit defines effect styles (0 local effect styles). Shadows/blur/glass effects are captured per component node (fx) in components/ios/*.md where read; macOS component nodes unread.
missing.gridStyles/layoutGuides: 0 grid styles in either file. iOS Layout Guides page (12892:60611) not read (quota). Layout values that exist as variables (margins, readable content width, status bar, home indicator, sheet radii, grabber) are in ios.dimensions.
